contract_term.value: 5 years with two (2) separate three (3) years renewals, total contract term up to a maximum of eleven (11) years
contract_term.quote: 3.3.2 Olds College will enter a contract for services for five (5) years. There will also be the opportunity to renew the contract for two (2) separate three (3) years renewals, based solely on the College's discretion. 3.3.3 The total contract term, if optional renewals are activated, may be up to a maximum of a eleven (11) years period.

scope_of_deliverables.value: Learning Management System (LMS) Platform & Support for Olds College, including platform services, support, and integration with Ellucian Banner.

value: Acceptance of Service Agreement Terms and Conditions (Section C - Item 9)
Comprehensive General Liability insurance in an amount of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000) inclusive per occurrence
Letter of Clearance from the Workers' Compensation Board
mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: 1 Proposal Certification Document (Section C) Acceptance of Service Agreement Terms and Conditions (Section C - Item 9) 2 Company Experience 3 Staff/Resources Experience 4 Proposed Project Solution and Approach 5 Pricing 6 The Proponent should also provide: • References (Item 8.6)

value: Accessibility: System that prioritizes ease of use and straightforward navigation
mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: #1 Accessibility • System that prioritizes ease of use and straightforward navigation

evaluation_criteria.quote: A. Company Experience 15; B. Staff/Resource Experience 5; C. Proposed Solution and Approach 40; D. Pricing 40; E. Reference Checks and Interview Outcome of reference checks - satisfactory yes/no; Total Points Available 100.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is submitted as part of the technical proposal in Schedule D. Prices must be in Canadian dollars and remain fixed for the 5-year term. The evaluation includes a 40-point weighting for Pricing (Total Cost of Proposal) and a 40-point weighting for Proposed Solution and Approach.
pricing_structure.quote: Proponents shall submit pricing in their Proposal, as requested in Schedule D - Scope of Work and Pricing Schedule, as follows: in Canadian dollars, and Prices must remain fixed and applicable to all goods and services, as detailed within this RFP, throughout the entire term of the 5 year agreement.

value.basis: all risks basis, including theft, and in an amount sufficient to cover such property in the Contractor's care, custody and control.

insurance_requirements.quote: Comprehensive General Liability insurance in an amount of not less than two million dollars ($2,000,000) inclusive per occurrence against third party claims for bodily injury, personal injury, and property damage (including loss of use thereof).

references_required.quote: Proponents should provide three references, where their company has provided the goods and services similar to those outlined in this RFP

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: RFP Evaluations & product demos: September 10 - November 15, 2026

vendor_experience_required.value: Proponents must provide a brief company history, organizational structure, and experience providing LMS systems and support or support for Moodle LMS. Experience working with post-secondary institutions using Ellucian Banner is also required. Staff/resource experience and qualifications, including resumes for proposed staff, must be provided. The evaluation criteria include 15 points for Company Experience and 5 points for Staff/Resource Experience.
vendor_experience_required.quote: a) a brief company history, including the length of time the company has been in business and the number of years providing the goods and services requested in this RFP; b) a copy of the Proponent's organizational structure, reporting structure, number of employees, etc.; c) an outline of the Proponent's experience in providing the goods and services set out in this RFP, including providing LMS systems and support; or support for the existing Moodle LMS (if applicable) d) the Proponent's experience working with post-secondary institutions previously, including with institutions that utilize Ellucian Banner... a) Staff and resource experience and qualifications, b) Proposed subcontracted resources - experience and qualifications (if applicable) c) A staffing model that designates personnel assigned to the project, including: i. resumes for any staff members proposed to work on the Project, and ii. identification of any work to be subcontracted.

value: Maintaining data security standards to safeguard sensitive learning materials and learner information
Ability to adhere to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA)

State whether the platform supports 'local' Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) support or whether MFA is dependent on the above SSO integration
